about.text: Arkhi distilled a second time, stronger than the first, at around 30 % alcohol: in Mongolian, arz.

links.name: Bianquis, Les alcools de lait en Mongolie (OCHA, 2004)

facts.v: The first alcohol out is stronger and is called 'essence'
More water changes give more spirit but a weaker taste, sometimes called 'suvs' (weak)
